images.title: Daljeet Kaur's pouches in pairs and in threes
images.purpose: Put the packing table of the story in front of the student before any number is said: the same 60 butter milk pouches packed in pairs and packed in threes.
images.composition: Two panels of 60 pouches on one baseline, the left grouped in pairs and the right grouped in threes, each with a plain caption.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two panels side by side, each with exactly 60 butter milk pouches. Every pouch is the same plain rounded rectangle (corner radius 8 px), 36 px wide and 44 px tall, filled teal #0072B2 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and no marking on it. Groups are drawn as rings: a ring is a rounded rectangle (corner radius 14 px) with a 4 px reddish purple #CC79A7 outline and no fill, 60 px tall, with 8 px of space between the ring and the pouches inside it. Gaps between neighbouring rings are 14 px both across and down. LEFT panel, pouches in pairs: exactly 30 rings in 6 columns by 5 rows, every ring 94 px wide and holding exactly 2 pouches side by side 6 px apart. The ring in column c (1 to 6) and row r (1 to 5) has its top left corner at x = 70 + 108 × (c − 1) and y = 200 + 74 × (r − 1); its two pouches have their top left corners 8 px below the ring's top edge, at 8 px and 50 px from the ring's left edge. The panel spans x 70 to 704 and y 200 to 556. RIGHT panel, pouches in threes: exactly 20 rings in 4 columns by 5 rows, every ring 136 px wide and holding exactly 3 pouches side by side 6 px apart. The ring in column c (1 to 4) and row r (1 to 5) has its top left corner at x = 800 + 150 × (c − 1) and y = 200 + 74 × (r − 1); its three pouches are at 8 px, 50 px and 92 px from the ring's left edge. The panel spans x 800 to 1386 and y 200 to 556. In all there are 120 pouches and 50 rings, no pouch outside a ring and no ring empty. Under the left panel, centred at x 387 and y 640, the caption Pouches in pairs; under the right panel, centred at x 1093 and y 640, the caption Pouches in threes, both in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). No number, no digit and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any number, digit or answer written anywhere in the frame
a panel with a number of pouches other than 60, a pair ring with other than 2 pouches or a triple ring with other than 3 pouches
images.takeaway: The same 60 pouches can be grouped in pairs and also in threes.
images.description: Two blocks of butter milk pouches, one packed in pairs and one packed in threes, with no numbers written.
images.context: Concept image for the hook, Daljeet Kaur's Pouches. It follows the idea of the opening pictures in your maths book (pouches packed in groups) and writes no number and gives no answer.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student count the pouches in a ring and the rings in a panel, but say no number on this picture. The slip to watch: thinking that 60 pouches can be packed in one way only.

image_decisions.why: The two panels of pouches in rings put the hook question, what other groups can be made, in front of the student without giving a number or an answer.
